$comment: MOTERVA B-led design system — semantic tokens (docs/03 artifact, ADR 0004). Dark is the flagship presentation; light shares components, information architecture, behavior and financial semantics. Every color value is verified byte-exact against the merged design lab's CSS custom properties by scripts/check-design-tokens.mjs, or explicitly marked lab:new. Contrast requirements are machine-verified (WCAG 2.x relative luminance; AA 4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI components).
status: PROVISIONAL — pending review in issue #10 (direction: B-led hybrid, founder 2026-11-03)

surface.raised.note: light elevation = white + border + shadow (A's discipline); value equals A's card

surface.sunken.note: dark sunken mirrors the page tone; light uses A's sunken

surface.overlay.note: light glass has no lab precedent — pending Phase-2 visual validation

line.default.note: decorative separators; not a control affordance (see ADR §status semantics)

line.strong.note: decorative; contrast intentionally below 3:1 so content, not chrome, dominates

accent.fill.note: identity accent carried into both modes

accent.text.note: lab amber #e8b23e is 1.94:1 on white — decorative fill only in light mode; #8a6118 is the AA text amber (pending Phase-2 visual validation)

interactive.text.note: the mode's primary interactive color; the focus ring uses the same token

statusSemantics.$comment: Presentation mapping anchored to the domain code — the checker parses packages/domain/src and fails if this mapping drifts. Two distinct layers: persisted OPERATION states (money truth) and APPROVAL workflow states (authorization truth). Presentation-only workflow labels from the design lab are mapped explicitly and never presented as persisted states.

IN_FLIGHT.label: In flight
IN_FLIGHT.meaning: submitted to provider — finality NOT confirmed; never display as settled/success

STATUS_UNKNOWN.label: Unknown
STATUS_UNKNOWN.meaning: outcome ambiguous — funds remain committed; resolve by original request ID, never resubmit blind

REQUIRES_HUMAN.label: Needs decision
REQUIRES_HUMAN.meaning: blocked — human decision required; exposure retained until resolved

SETTLED.label: Settled
SETTLED.meaning: provider-verified finality (readback attestation — conservative-finality contract of the provider PR)

CANCELLED.label: Cancelled
CANCELLED.meaning: cancelled before execution — no funds moved

active.label: Mandate active
active.meaning: spending authority currently in force (versioned; envelope + expiry enforced)

superseded.label: Superseded
superseded.meaning: replaced by a newer mandate version; the dispatch gate re-checks and blocks queued dispatch

expired.label: Mandate expired
expired.meaning: authority lapsed; re-authorization required before any spend

revoked.label: Mandate revoked
revoked.meaning: explicitly revoked; queued dispatch is blocked and journaled

valid.label: Approval valid
valid.meaning: binds exact plan digest + terms; single-use economic authorization

consumed.label: Consumed
consumed.meaning: used by its reservation; retries reuse the original request ID, never a new approval

invalidated.label: Invalidated
invalidated.meaning: terms changed — structurally stale; cannot authorize anything

revoked.label: Revoked
revoked.meaning: explicitly revoked; the dispatch gate rechecks and blocks pending dispatch

presentationOnlyStates.$comment: Design-lab workflow labels that are NOT persisted operation states. The UI may show them as progress steps only, mapped to the persisted truth below.

APPROVED.label: Approved
APPROVED.meaning: an approval exists and binds exact terms; it is authorization, not money state

SUBMITTED.label: Submitted
SUBMITTED.meaning: the lab chip 'SUBMITTED' is the presentation name for the persisted IN_FLIGHT state

rules: Never color-only: every state renders glyph + label + tone.

The verified (green) tone is reserved exclusively for SETTLED and RECONCILED, which require provider-readback attestation; no visual label may imply settlement or irreversible payment success. IN_FLIGHT and SUBMITTING are transit (amber).
The commitment column must equal the domain's commitmentStateFor(operationState) — the checker verifies this against packages/domain/src/commitments.ts.
STATUS_UNKNOWN and REQUIRES_HUMAN retain exposure (commitment 'unknown'); funds are never silently freed.

typography.$comment: Identity stack from candidate B; families SIL OFL 1.1, self-hosted via @fontsource-variable npm packages (dependency presence is machine-checked; full license posture is documented in the component ledger and ADR, not audited by the checker). IBM Plex families remain design-lab dependencies (candidate A reference), not part of the production system.

family.mono.use: ALL financial numerals, currency amounts, IDs, timestamps — monospaced digits guarantee tabular alignment

numeric.feature.use: any numeric run rendered in family.ui (fallback when mono is not used); currency codes are always explicit (USD 2,150.00), never bare symbols

readabilityFloor.rule: Essential production content — financial amounts, approval details, status explanations, form labels and inputs, error messages, and action labels — MUST render at size sm (0.8rem) or larger, with md (0.9rem) the default for financial amounts and body text. Sizes xs (0.72rem) and 2xs (0.64rem) are restricted to nonessential annotations (metadata, HUD stamps, decorative micro-labels). Any essential-content use of xs/2xs is a defect; the restriction is enforced in real-browser review (320px and 200%-zoom gates) during Phase 2, not by this checker.
readabilityFloor.origin: normative rule added in CTO review of PR #31 (2026-11-03)

2xs.use: HUD stamps, dense captions — NONESSENTIAL only (lab: 0.64)

sm.use: MINIMUM for essential content; secondary text, chips (lab: 0.78–0.82)

spacing.$comment: 4px base grid, normalized from lab usage.

focus.$comment: identical geometry in both modes (design-lab base.css); the color is the mode's interactive.text token, ≥3:1 against every surface

reducedMotion.rule: under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, every animation/transition duration becomes 0.01ms (design-lab base.css gate); entrance staggers collapse to 0

breakpoints.$comment: tableCollapse = missions table → stacked cards (below 640px); verified no-horizontal-scroll at xs/sm

elevation.$comment: Dark mode builds hierarchy with surface tones + hairlines (no heavy shadows — low-end GPU discipline from the B critique); light mode adds a soft shadow on raised surfaces.
elevation.dark: surface tone steps + line.default hairlines; glass overlay uses surface.overlay + backdrop-filter with solid fallback
elevation.light: card/raised white + border line.default + shadow 0 1px 2px rgba(24,24,27,0.06), 0 4px 12px rgba(24,24,27,0.06)
